studies.title: The llama
studies.caption: Llamas carry loads through the high Andean landscape. Their role in transport joined the wool, meat and fuel that herds supplied to highland communities.
studies.prompt: Eye-level full-body llama Lama glama on Andean puna grassland, long neck, long curved banana-shaped ears, modest woolly tan-white coat, slender legs and split padded feet; light balanced woven panniers over a simple blanket, no rider. Distant mountains and stone path, not short-faced fluffy alpaca.
